description: The fictional demo estate for a demo install (D-33), generated by seed/demo-estate.gen.mjs (node seed/demo-estate.gen.mjs from src/adapters/azure). A superset of seed/walkthrough-world.json: every walkthrough row, enriched, plus 44 more business applications in five portfolios, their owners, dependencies, deployment targets, components, deployments, change requests, decisions (two standing exceptions among them), two past approval answers, reviews, documents, delivery links, pipeline references and intake requests, and the data taxonomy: data locations, data mappings, data uses, the owners of data domains and locations with their ownership decisions, and one tier assessment (the domain tree itself is configuration, in seed/demo-binding.patch.json). The story is seen from about 2026-11-24. Every ID is a patterned placeholder and every name, organization and URL is fictional.

columns.reason: Contractors needed to sign in the next morning, and the change "Contractor Portal sign-in page update" brings the fix into the pipeline.

columns.statement: Accept the daily allowance rates loaded by hand in the live app on November 6.

columns.exceptionStandard: Every change reaches People Prod through the release pipeline.
columns.reason: The rates are data, not code, and the pipeline release repeats them once it runs again.
